cz: 允许城市按发展阶段修建和升级城墙
en: Allows cities to build and upgrade walls as they develop

cz: 取消后停止新建和升级，已有城墙保留
en: Removing this option stops new construction and upgrades. Existing walls remain

cz: 允许城市在外围修建三格宽的护城河
en: Allows cities to dig a moat three tiles wide around their outskirts

cz: 同时选择城墙时等待石墙建成；单独选择时首次大厅完工及每次升级完成后重建
en: With city walls selected waits for stone walls. Alone builds when the first hall is finished and rebuilds after each completed hall upgrade

cz: 大厅建成后修建官道，优先连接附近已通往本国首都的村庄
en: After a hall is completed builds roads to nearby villages already connected to the national capital

cz: 仅走陆地并绕开山体与城墙，隔海村庄暂不接通；取消后已有道路保留
en: Uses existing land and avoids mountains and walls. Overseas villages remain disconnected. Existing roads remain when removed
